verdict.rationale: Ramp documents OAuth 2.0 client-credentials apps with granular resource:permission scopes and explicit least-privilege guidance ("configure only the scopes your app needs"). It also documents a dedicated agent-identity model: one key per agent tied to a human sponsor, flexible per-agent read/do permissions, and full attribution. On top of that come CLI `agent login` via client credentials, role-respecting MCP admin restrictions, and session expiry for read-only and read-write sessions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that per-agent scoped keys work as documented.
